heading: **17 June 2026**
body:
**MNase check for nucleosome samples**

Dilute 1 uL MNase to 1000 uL of total solution with NF water. 1 uL of this solution has 2 gel units of the enzyme (MNase-dil).

Treat samples at 37 C, 15 mins. Add 1.1 uL EGTA (0.5 M) to stop the reaction.

NOTE: Use 5 uL of each sample for this test except for the control samples.
title: MNase check for nucleosome samples
